name: hex2RGB
title: Convert hexadecimal colors to sRGB objects

origin.description: Read #RRGGBB strings into sRGB coordinates, or into linearized RGB when gamma is true.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Hexadecimal color strings. A suffix past the first seven characters is ignored.

arguments.name: gamma
arguments.text: Whether to linearize the channels. A true value returns class RGB; a false value returns class sRGB.

origin.details: substr keeps the first seven characters, so #RRGGBBAA loses its alpha. Each remaining pair is a channel from 0 to 255, divided by 255. When gamma is true, ftrans with exponent 2.4 is applied: a channel above 0.03928 uses the power branch, and a smaller channel is divided by 12.92. Names on x become row names of the coordinate matrix.
origin.value: An sRGB object when gamma is false, and an RGB object when gamma is true. The coords slot is a matrix with columns R, G, and B.

translation.description: Read #RRGGBB strings into sRGB coordinates, or into linearized RGB when gamma is true.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One hex string, a sequence of hex strings, or a mapping whose keys are the row names.

arguments.name: gamma
arguments.text: Whether to linearize the channels. True, a non-zero number, or the spellings T and TRUE return space RGB. False, zero, or F and FALSE return space sRGB.

translation.details: The first seven characters are kept. Each channel is an integer divided by 255. gamma true applies the same 2.4 transfer: above 0.03928 the power branch, otherwise the channel divided by 12.92. An empty input raises invalid color matrix. A string that is not # and six hex digits raises color error - hex values required.
translation.value: A HexRGB object. space is sRGB or RGB, coords is an n by 3 float64 array, and names is the row names or None. columns is R, G, B.
